zh.title: 优化
items: **上下文占用圆环**：主圆环改为显示实际发送给模型的上下文量，更符合「上下文占用」心智；自动压缩仍在后台按独立压力水位判定。
**用量提示更干净**：圆环 hover 只保留「上下文」与缓存/额度信息，不再混入压缩压力文案。
**过程块折叠偏好**：手动收起过程时间线后，流式更新中不会被自动展开重新打开。
**侧栏状态更清晰**：区分进行中 / 已完成等状态；排队消息与 Goal 条目背景微调。

zh.title: 修复
items: **OpenAI Responses 流挂起**：收到 `response.completed` / failed / `[DONE]` 后及时结束流，并增加空闲超时，避免 Grok 等模型把 `isStreaming` 卡死。
**Goal Runner 不启动 / 递归启动**：intake 建 plan 后自动 kick runner；只在 goal-accepted 边沿启动，防止递归 auto-start；计划升级与 intake 流交接更稳。
**切换会话丢队列**：跨会话切换时保留排队消息与草稿。
**Workspace 黄点不灭**：无进行中任务时侧栏工作区黄点正确熄灭；路径末尾斜杠差异不再误判。
**通知点击跳转**：系统通知点击可定位到对应源消息。
**Responses 历史工具名**：回放时规范化带点号/空格的旧 function name，避免请求被拒。
**TUI 恢复会话隔离**：按当前工作区过滤可恢复会话，并兼容旧 store。
**模型选择器滚动跳动**：悬停上方模型不再强制滚回当前选中项。
**过程时间线闪烁**：流式过程中时间线条目更稳定。

zh.title: CLI / npm
items: 本版 GitHub Release 继续附带 CLI 归档（与 Desktop 同 tag）：`peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`。
可安装：`npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`（需仓库已配置 `NPM_TOKEN`；否则仅发 GitHub Release，可从 Release 资产手动装 CLI）。
安装后执行 `peer --version` 应输出 `peer 0.0.1-beta.40`。
会话与设置仍落在 `~/.peer-agent`，与 Desktop 共享。

en.title: Improvements
items: **Context occupancy ring**: The main ring now shows the actual context sent to the model, matching the “context occupancy” mental model; auto-compact still decides in the background using a separate pressure waterline.
**Cleaner usage tooltip**: Ring hover keeps only context plus cache/quota info—no mixed compact-pressure copy.
**Process-block collapse preference**: After you manually collapse the process timeline, stream updates no longer force it open again.
**Clearer sidebar states**: Distinguish in-progress vs completed; queued messages and Goal rows get subtle background polish.

en.title: Fixes
items: **OpenAI Responses stream hang**: End the stream promptly on `response.completed` / failed / `[DONE]`, plus an idle timeout so models like Grok no longer stick `isStreaming`.

**Goal Runner not starting / recursive start**: After intake creates a plan, kick the runner automatically; start only on the goal-accepted edge to prevent recursive auto-start; stabler plan upgrade and intake stream handoff.
**Queue lost when switching sessions**: Keep queued messages and drafts across session switches.
**Workspace yellow dot stuck on**: When no tasks are running, the sidebar workspace yellow dot turns off correctly; trailing slash path differences no longer mis-detect.
**Notification click jump**: System notification clicks navigate to the source message.
**Responses history tool names**: Normalize old function names with dots/spaces on replay so requests are not rejected.
**TUI resume isolation**: Filter resumable sessions by current workspace and stay compatible with the old store.
**Model picker scroll jump**: Hovering a model above no longer forces scroll back to the current selection.
**Process timeline flicker**: Timeline items stay more stable during streaming.

en.title: CLI / npm
items: This GitHub Release still ships the CLI archive under the same Desktop tag: `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`.
Install: `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta` (needs `NPM_TOKEN` in the repo; otherwise only the GitHub Release is published and you can install the CLI from Release assets manually).
After install, `peer --version` should print `peer 0.0.1-beta.40`.
Sessions and settings still live under `~/.peer-agent` and are shared with Desktop.
